text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَا تَسْمَعُوا۟ لِهَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَٱلْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening coordinator that resumes the prior dispute and carries it into a quoted hostile strategy
words.prose: The opening {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the quoted strategy arrive as continuation, not as a detached anecdote. Before the reporting verb is heard, the reader is told to keep the prior dispute in view: organized non-hearing is another move in the same opposition. Its prefixed, brief onset also makes linkage the first formal feature of the report, a compact hinge into fully voiced hostile speech.

topics.headline: resumptive opening into hostile speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech policy continues the surrounding rejection instead of beginning a neutral new scene.
topics.reason: The prefixed coordinator is attached to the reporting verb and the attachment evidence treats the ayah as a reporting clause that opens into quoted content.

topics.headline: light connector launches voiced report
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the connector as a compact hinge into the fully voiced hostile report.
topics.reason: The written prefixing and brief onset support a compact transition from linkage into speech.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect reporting verb that opens direct hostile quotation; singular verb-initial form precedes a plural relative subject
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, stance, report, and pronouncement; here the local frame selects direct reported speech that performs a social tactic
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah's inner speech scene with a singular verb before the plural subject is named. The direct quotation matters: the opposition is not summarized as belief but made audible as instructions to manage attention and noise. Because the form is plain Form I saying, the mechanism is not fabricated revelation but an actual hostile utterance that tries to control reception, unlike the fabricated-speech contrast (69:44). In the surah's speech thread, this hostile saying contrasts with faithful confession and calling (41:30; 41:33).

topics.headline: singular report before plural subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the group first as one voiced stance, then as the plural class who owns that speech.
topics.reason: QAC marks a 3ms perfect before the masculine plural relative subject, and attachment evidence identifies the following relative phrase as the subject.

topics.headline: direct quotation exposes tactics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the mechanics of opposition in the speakers' own command sequence rather than receiving a summary of their disbelief.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the following prohibition, imperative, and purpose clause as the quoted complement of the speech verb.

topics.headline: plain saying rather than fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes this hostile speech from false attribution: the fault here is reception management through a real utterance.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form I speech, while the contrast with fabricated speech in 69:44 belongs to a different derived form.

topics.headline: speech thread contrasts hostile and faithful utterance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that speech can either confess and call or sabotage reception; this occurrence belongs to the hostile side of that thread.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect this speech to Qurʾān discourse and same-surah speech contrasts, including faithful confession at 41:30.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun that makes the speakers a defined class through the following relative-clause verb
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not leave the speakers anonymous. It points forward to the defining relative clause, so the command against listening is owned by a morally classified group rather than by a vague public voice. At the boundary, the prior judged reference gives way to active denier-speakers who now issue policy.

topics.headline: speakers defined by following clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers are identified by what defines them, not by tribe, name, or anonymous crowd status.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the postverbal subject head, and attachment evidence ties it to the following relative clause.

topics.headline: boundary shifts from prior pronoun chain to explicit class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from prior judged reference into an active class of speakers issuing policy.
topics.reason: The subject arrives after the reporting verb and changes the scene from prior reference to explicit relative classification.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural denial in the relative clause; objectless here, it classifies the speakers before their anti-Qurʾān command is quoted
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, rejection, and ingratitude; here the local form selects settled denial that becomes public reception-control
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) makes denial the settled identity behind the quoted commands. Because the verb appears without an explicit object, the denial is broad before the named Qurʾān becomes its immediate target. The root's covering pressure becomes auditory in this ayah: inner refusal turns outward as a policy to block the hearing channel. The gratitude-denial contrast (14:7) sharpens this as ingratitude toward heard address, and the denier label carries into the next consequence scene (41:27).

topics.headline: perfect denial defines the speakers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commands are presented as the manifestation of an already-settled denial.
topics.reason: The perfect verb remains inside the relative clause that defines the reporting subject before the quotation begins.

topics.headline: objectless denial before specific target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the named Qurʾān is a concrete target of a broader settled posture, not the first cause of denial.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has no explicit object, while the later object phrase names the recitation targeted by the speech.

topics.headline: covering pressure becomes auditory policy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial is enacted through sensory control: covered recognition becomes commanded non-hearing.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the covering/denial field to the immediately following hearing prohibition without making a separate root sense override the local perfect verb.

topics.headline: denial thread frames the scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this denial belongs to a larger evaluative thread: ingratitude becomes sabotage of address and carries into the next consequence scene.
topics.reason: The source rows cite the gratitude contrast at 14:7 and the same-surah continuation at 41:27; locally these remain framing contrasts rather than controls on the parse.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive particle governing the following listening verb and beginning the quoted strategy with commanded abstention
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the quoted policy with prohibition. Its scope is local and sharp: first forbid receptive listening, then the next command will provide the noisy substitute. The particle turns hearing from an ordinary faculty into behavior the speakers try to police.

topics.headline: prohibition governs listening only
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the line is a command against reception, not a description of failed listening.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support mark the particle as prohibitive before the jussive-shaped imperfect.

topics.headline: strategy opens with prevention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that domination starts by preventing attention before it adds active interference.
topics.reason: The first quoted clause is the prohibition, and the coordinated imperative follows as a separate positive tactic.

topics.headline: separate particle displays imposed control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees negation as an imposed instruction placed over hearing rather than as part of the verb's lexical meaning.
topics.reason: The particle remains a separate written form and functions as hostile tactical prohibition in the quoted speech.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural listening/heeding under prohibition, directed by a lām phrase toward the named Qurʾān
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, listening, receptive attention, report, and heeding; here the local construction selects directed reception that the hostile speakers forbid
words.prose: {{ar:تَسْمَعُوا۟}} ({{tr:tasmaʿū}}) is hearing placed under command-prohibition. The missing final nūn and the second-person plural form make the audience grammatically visible as people whose receptive attention is being controlled. In context, the root reaches beyond acoustics: the feared act is listening that could become heeding of the Qurʾān, the very relation that noise is then ordered to block. The contrast is concrete: listening brings recognition in another Qurʾān scene (72:1), while this surah's hearing faculty can testify (41:20; 41:22), so the command resists a charged channel.

topics.headline: listening governed by prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that listening is treated as governable conduct, not as an accidental sensory event.
topics.reason: The imperfect follows the prohibitive particle with final nūn omitted, matching the local jussive-shaped prohibition.

topics.headline: hearing as directed receptive uptake
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ban targets attentive uptake of the Qurʾān, not merely sound reaching the ear.
topics.reason: The following lām-governed phrase supplies the object domain, and the root's local range includes listening as receptive heeding.

topics.headline: same addressees carry the tactic chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows one addressed group from non-listening through noise-making to hoped victory.
topics.reason: The second-person plural morphology recurs across the prohibition, imperative, and projected outcome.

topics.headline: reception becomes first battlefield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees noisy interference as secondary to the prior fear of receptive attention.
topics.reason: The prohibition clause precedes the coordinated laghw command, making blocked reception the first step in the strategy.

topics.headline: hearing thread is inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a Qurʾānic hearing channel associated with recognition and testimony is here resisted by command.
topics.reason: The rows contrast listening that recognizes wonder at 72:1 and the hearing faculty thread at 41:20 and 41:22 with the command against listening here.

words.gloss_range: prefixed preposition that directs the forbidden listening toward the present named Qurʾān
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) makes the forbidden hearing directional. The command is not about stray audibility; it forbids turning receptive attention toward the present Qurʾānic address. By fusing onto the demonstrative, the particle compresses governance and pointing before the object is named.

topics.headline: preposition directs listening toward its object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibited act is attentive orientation toward the Qurʾān, not mere sound exposure.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the demonstrative object phrase and links the listening verb to its target domain.

topics.headline: prefixed governance binds to deixis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears the relation to this present object being built before the Qurʾān is named.
topics.reason: The prefixed preposition forms a tight unit with the demonstrative, and the following apposition names the governed object.

topics.headline: first domain differs from later interference domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the difference between listening toward the Qurʾān and making noise within its recitation domain.
topics.reason: The lām phrase belongs to the first prohibition, while the later domain phrase belongs to the noise command.

words.gloss_range: proximal masculine singular demonstrative governed by the preposition and resolved by apposition to the Qurʾān
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) points before the noun identifies. That order makes the target immediate in the scene and then doctrinally recognizable as the Qurʾān. The command is therefore aimed at a present recitation-event, not at an abstract idea safely offstage.

topics.headline: present pointing resolved by the named noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the object as both immediately present and explicitly named.
topics.reason: The demonstrative is governed by the preposition and resolved by the following appositional noun.

topics.headline: deixis plus apposition builds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the hostile command confront a live recitation-event and not merely a general doctrine.
topics.reason: The object phrase works in two steps: proximal pointing followed by explicit naming.

words.gloss_range: definite singular named Qurʾān in genitive apposition, the recognized recitation-discourse targeted by forbidden listening
words.root_gloss_range: reciting, reading, proclaiming, and gathering discourse into voiced form; here the local noun names the Qurʾān as known heard proclamation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقُرْءَانِ}} ({{tr:al-qurʾāni}}) names the object that the demonstrative has made present. The definite noun fixes the target as the recognized Qurʾān, and the root pressure joins voiced recitation with gathered discourse. That is why the hostile answer is not interpretation but noise: void speech is chosen to fracture meaningful proclamation. The resisted object is also the guidance-bearing Qurʾān (17:9), set inside the surah's Qurʾān thread from Arabic clarity to later objection about its signs (41:3; 41:44). Even its hamza contour can vary in recitation without changing the target, making sound texture relevant while preserving the same referent.

topics.headline: named target completes the prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition has an unmistakable known object, not a vague demonstrative target.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive, and appositional to the demonstrative inside the lām-governed phrase.

topics.headline: gathered recitation attacked by void sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lexical contrast between organized meaningful recitation and the commanded production of empty speech.
topics.reason: The root range supports recitation and gathered discourse here, while the local contrast with laghw explains the choice of disruptive noise.

topics.headline: guidance and clarity thread is resisted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opposition attacks the hearing channel through which Qurʾānic guidance and clarity would reach its audience.
topics.reason: The rows cite the guidance function at 17:9 and same-surah Qurʾān references at 41:3 and 41:44 as framing contrasts for the local anti-reception command.

topics.headline: hamza contour varies without changing target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target word itself has recitational texture in an ayah about sound, while the referent remains the same.
topics.reason: The accepted hamza-smoothed contour affects oral texture without replacing the local noun or its referent.

words.gloss_range: coordinator that yokes the active disruption command to the preceding prohibition
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from prevention to active interference. It binds the noise-command to the no-listening command as one strategy: abstain from reception, then fill the recitation domain with void speech. Because the connector is prefixed to the imperative, coordination and disruption are seen and heard as one compact unit before the final motive is disclosed.

topics.headline: coordination turns noise into counterpart tactic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that noise-making is not an afterthought but the active counterpart to non-listening.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the imperative with the prior prohibition inside the quote.

topics.headline: prefixed connector fuses to imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears coordination and disruptive action as one compact tactical unit.
topics.reason: The coordinator is orthographically prefixed to the imperative, and the variant keeps that command phrase acoustically prominent.

topics.headline: pivot prepares the purpose clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command pair being assembled before the final motive is disclosed.
topics.reason: The coordinated command is the parent frame for the following purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: Form I second-person plural imperative to produce laghw, locally an ordered act of void or disruptive speech inside the Qurʾān's recitation domain
words.root_gloss_range: idle, vain, void, irrelevant, or consequence-less speech and activity; here the imperative weaponizes that emptiness as deliberate counter-sound
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَوْا۟}} ({{tr:ilghaw}}) is the ayah's active sabotage command. The root's void-speech pressure is not merely background; it makes anti-meaning the chosen tool against meaningful recitation. Because the verb is imperative and takes its domain through the following phrase rather than a direct object, the command is to invade the recitation-space with disruptive sound, turning what believers turn away from (23:3) into a hostile prescription. Its rare imperative profile makes the normally avoided speech-quality abrupt and actional, while the rough ghayn texture and recitational contour make the disruption audible. Across the boundary, the move shifts from distorted inner valuation to external acoustic distortion.

topics.headline: imperative sabotage linked to non-listening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second command gives non-listening an active method: replace reception with disruptive utterance.
topics.reason: The imperative is coordinated with the prohibition and keeps the same second-person plural audience.

topics.headline: no direct object, domain supplied after the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not generic heckling but interference placed inside the Qurʾān's event-space.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no direct object and is followed by the domain phrase governed by the preposition.

topics.headline: void speech weaponized against meaningful recitation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices anti-meaning itself being ordered as the counter to gathered Qurʾānic meaning.
topics.reason: The root range supports laghw as void speech, and the local contrast with the named Qurʾān makes that emptiness tactically active.

topics.headline: usually described laghw becomes ordered behavior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the abruptness of turning a normally avoided speech-quality into something commanded.
topics.reason: The supplied distribution marks laghw as mostly nominal, while the local form is an imperative.

topics.headline: avoided laghw becomes hostile prescription
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a moral inversion: what should be turned away from is ordered as a tool of opposition.
topics.reason: The contrast with turning away from laghw at 23:3 survives as an evaluative inversion while local grammar keeps the imperative sense.

topics.headline: laghw belongs to one speech-control field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole tactic as discourse-channel control: saying orders void speech to block hearing and seek dominance.
topics.reason: The local ayah explicitly joins speech, hearing, Qurʾān, laghw, and hoped prevailing in one quoted strategy.

topics.headline: rough sound supports the disruption image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the disruptive command as acoustically textured in an ayah about counter-sound.
topics.reason: The variant and phonetic rows affect oral contour and roughness without changing the local imperative or root identity.

topics.headline: inner distortion shifts to outer noise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary movement from distorted valuation to distorted auditory space.
topics.reason: The boundary row links prior perceptual beautification to the current acoustic disruption as a scene-level transition.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus masculine singular suffix marking the Qurʾān-recitation domain in which the ordered disruption is to occur
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}) completes the sabotage command by giving it a domain. The masculine suffix resumes the same present Qurʾān targeted by the listening ban, while the preposition lets space, event-time, and discourse-topic overlap. The noise is therefore not merely around the scene; it is inserted into the recitation event itself.

topics.headline: suffix binds back to the Qurʾān target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disruption is tied to the same object as the hearing ban.
topics.reason: The 3ms suffix agrees with the masculine singular demonstrative/noun complex that named the Qurʾān target.

topics.headline: preposition marks internal disruption domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the overlap of space, event-time, and discourse domain in the command to disrupt.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase modifies the imperative and marks the sphere where laghw is to occur.

topics.headline: postposed compact tail completes command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader discovers only after the action word that the noisemaking is to be internal interference.
topics.reason: The preposition and suffix compress domain and antecedent in one postposed phrase after the imperative.

words.gloss_range: hope-purpose particle with second-person plural suffix, making the addressees subjects of the projected outcome
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّكُمْ}} ({{tr:laʿallakum}}) turns the two commands into a purpose strategy. The same addressed group is carried into the outcome clause as hoped winners, but the particle leaves that outcome desired rather than guaranteed. The grammar exposes anxiety inside the hostile plan: they can command non-listening and noise, but they can only project victory.

topics.headline: addressees governed as outcome subjects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same audience commanded to abstain and disrupt is made the projected beneficiary of victory.
topics.reason: The particle governs the 2mp suffix as subject and the following verb as predicate.

topics.headline: victory remains suspended in expectation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the confident tactics still grammatically admit uncertainty about success.
topics.reason: The particle's hope-purpose force fits strategic tarajjī in hostile speech rather than an asserted result.

topics.headline: purpose clause reveals motive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retrospectively understands the two commands as instruments of domination.
topics.reason: The purpose clause follows the command pair and gives their intended outcome.

words.gloss_range: second-person plural imperfect predicate after the hope-purpose particle; projected prevailing with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: prevailing, overcoming, overpowering, defeating, and dominance; here the field is transferred to discourse-control and left open by object omission
words.prose: {{ar:تَغْلِبُونَ}} ({{tr:taghlibūn}}) is the final motive word: the goal is to prevail. The same second-person plural audience remains visible at the close, so victory is assigned as the hoped future of the group told not to listen and to make noise. Because no object is named, the imagined overcoming spreads across reciter, audience, encounter, and Qurʾānic effect. Yet the verb remains under the hope-purpose particle, so the close lands on projected domination, not secured victory; against secure divine dominance (12:21), this is a fragile human hope produced by noise. The discourse event itself is framed as a contest over public reception, denial's aspiration is voiced as a speech strategy, and the final long ending gives that still-uncertain outcome a firm acoustic landing.

topics.headline: same addressees receive projected victory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commanded audience remains grammatically visible as the hoped future victors.
topics.reason: The 2mp imperfect ending matches the earlier command subjects and functions as the predicate after the purpose particle.

topics.headline: object omission broadens victory field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hoped victory is intentionally open-ended, reaching beyond a single named opponent.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no explicit object, and translation support warns that the Arabic leaves the object compressed.

topics.headline: imperfect under hope particle projects result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar undercuts certainty while preserving the speakers' ambition.
topics.reason: The imperfect is the predicate under the hope-purpose particle and keeps its final nūn rather than sharing the earlier prohibited jussive form.

topics.headline: dominance field moves into attention control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the public reception of the Qurʾān framed as a contest for dominance over attention.
topics.reason: The root's dominance range is locally applied to the sound and attention strategy named in the preceding commands.

topics.headline: final word reveals motive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader only fully understands the commands at the close, when they resolve into a desire to win the encounter.
topics.reason: The verb closes both the quotation and the ayah, retrospectively naming the motive behind the command pair.

topics.headline: human hoped dominance contrasts secure dominance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast between secure divine dominance and a human hope to dominate by interference.
topics.reason: The rows contrast divine dominance over His affair at 12:21 with the local projected human prevailing under a hope particle.

topics.headline: denial speaks toward dominance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that denial's aspiration is voiced as a strategy for overcoming, even while the object remains unstated.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence rows tie dominance language to denial and speech scenes, and the local quote makes that relation direct.

topics.headline: final cadence lands on hoped victory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah close firmly on an outcome that remains grammatically projected.
topics.reason: The final imperfect form supplies the acoustic close and presents dominance as an event hoped for rather than a settled title.

branches.scope_ar:
1. يدخل فيه أصل الجمع والاجتماع، وضم الشيء بعضه إلى بعض، وجمع الماء والطعام والناس والضيف، واجتماع عظام الظهر، وما ألحقته المقاييس بقرية من جهة الجمع.
2. قراءة القرآن والكلام؛ لفظه مجموعا؛ إقراء الغير؛ المدارسة والاستقراء؛ القارئ والقراء والتقرؤ للتنسك أو التفقه
branches.scope_en:
1. This covers the root image of collecting, joining, and gathering: things gathered together, water or food gathered in a vessel, people gathered in a settlement, guests gathered around a dish, and the back as gathered bones.
2. Reading or reciting Quran or speech, uttering it as a gathered whole, making another read, studying together or eliciting reading, and reader or devotional-learning uses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain قَالَ / لَا تَسْمَعُوا / ٱلْغَوْا / تَغْلِبُونَ links speech, blocked hearing, injected noise, and hoped-for dominance.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spoken plural command couples refusal to hear with mixed raised sound in the recitation's channel. Occupying that channel is the means by which the speakers hope to overpower the recitation.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech launches the coordinated instruction.
Auditory perception is the channel the command tells the group to close.
Recitation supplies the target signal against which the counter-sound operates.
Mixed raised noise supplies the interference that masks the target signal.
Overpowering is the stated hoped-for result, making the interference tactical.

changed_reading.before: The disbelievers merely refuse to listen and make noise.
changed_reading.after: They issue a coordinated acoustic-jamming instruction in which channel occupation is a technique of domination.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كَفَرُوا, تَسْمَعُوا, قُرْءَان, and ٱلْغَوْا permit a second mechanism at the level of recognition and account, not volume alone.
baseline_models.mechanism: The gathered recitation is denied uptake by treating it as material to be thrown out of account. Blocking hearing as understanding and acceptance lets the group control not only what is audible but what is allowed to count.

activation_trace.role: Denial and obstruction of truth supply the governing posture toward the message.
Hearing as understanding, acceptance, and compliance is the uptake being blocked.
Gathering and coherence make the Qur'an an assembled body of meaning to be socially disaggregated.
What is cast out of account supplies the mechanism of semantic nullification.
Dominance is achieved by controlling what the audience recognizes as consequential.

changed_reading.before: Noise makes the recitation difficult to hear.
changed_reading.after: The campaign also tries to remove the recitation from communal account so that hearing never becomes acknowledgment or obedience.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural speakers combine circulating قول with the group-tongue branch of لغو and a collective hope of prevailing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The counter-speech may be sustained social saturation rather than a single interruption. Widely circulated talk and a group tongue obsessed with its own speech can crowd the recitation out by making the rival discourse ambient.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies a social carrier for the instruction.
The recited discourse is the rival voice the ambient talk seeks to crowd out.
Fixation on speech and a group's habitual tongue turn momentary noise into a repeated social idiom.
The hoped-for victory gives that social saturation its competitive purpose.

changed_reading.before: The scene is a momentary heckle during recitation.
changed_reading.after: It can also be a campaign to build a rival communal tongue whose constant circulation makes revelation socially inaudible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening presents the Qur'an as differentiated into intelligible parts and explicitly expressed. The focus noise is therefore anti-articulation: mixed sound collapses the perceptual distinctions by which a detailed utterance becomes understandable.

activation_trace.role: Detail that discloses parts and meanings supplies the articulation the noise works to blur.
Explicit expression supplies the intelligibility targeted by deliberate acoustic mixing.
Understanding and acceptance identify the threatened result of clear articulation.
The recitation carries the differentiated utterance into the contested auditory field.
Mixed noise functions as an anti-detailing medium that erases audible boundaries.

structural_cues: 41:3 names a detailed Arabic Qur'an before the sequence of non-hearing and the focus command.
The focus repeats Qur'an as the object, so the contrast is between articulated recitation and mixed counter-sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies differentiation, explicitness, and mixed noise; I supply the arrow that mixing sound destroys perceptual separation. A live alternative is simple heckling without an informational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The opponents try to be louder than the recitation.
changed_reading.after: They try to undo its audible differentiation, replacing articulated meaning with an undivided sound field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier non-hearing is described through coverings, ear-weight, and a barrier. The focus command turns those claimed conditions into a collective practice: mixed noise externally manufactures the deafness and separation the speakers had described as already present.

activation_trace.role: The earlier failure to understand or accept establishes the condition later made imperative.
Protective covering supplies the inner enclosure that public noise externalizes.
Literal heaviness in the ear supplies the aural blockage the group now helps produce.
Prevention of access supplies the relational barrier created between reciter and audience.
Covering anchors the focus action as deliberate concealment rather than passive incapacity.
Mixed raised noise is the external material from which the barrier is made.

structural_cues: 41:4 states that most do not hear, 41:5 supplies the anatomy of blockage, and 41:26 converts non-hearing into a plural command.
The move from self-description to coordinated imperative makes the barrier operational.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated cover, weight, barrier, and noise images; I infer that the focus socially manufactures an earlier claimed incapacity. The alternative is that 41:5 remains only a rhetorical description and 41:26 a separate tactic.

changed_reading.before: The audience happens to be unreceptive and later adds noise.
changed_reading.after: The audience collectively engineers unreceptivity, building an external acoustic version of its claimed covered hearts and burdened ears.

context_deltas.mechanism: The auditory faculty the focus tries to suppress later speaks as an informed witness, while attempted covering is explicitly denied. Read retrospectively, 'do not listen' becomes failed evidence control: the sense may be denied uptake, but it cannot be prevented from registering and testifying.

activation_trace.role: Testimony stated from knowledge turns sensory registration into adverse evidence.
The hearing faculty itself becomes the witness the earlier command cannot silence.
Covering and concealment are explicitly linked to the failed attempt to escape sensory testimony.
Covering in the focus anchors the later witness scene as a reversal of concealment.
The command targets the same auditory channel that later bears witness.

structural_cues: 41:20 makes hearing a witness and 41:22 places concealment directly beside that testimony.
The focus joins covering with a command against hearing, allowing the later scene to reverse both terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies suppressed hearing, failed concealment, and later testimony; I infer a retrospective evidence-control mechanism. The materially live alternative is that testimony is only a consequence and was never part of the speakers' conscious aim.

changed_reading.before: The command aims only to prevent persuasion in the present.
changed_reading.after: It also reads as a doomed attempt to suppress the sensory record that will later testify against its makers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired companions beautify the surrounding worldview, and the misled later identify agents who led them astray. That social ecology sharpens the plural focus command into a peer-amplification network: circulating group speech makes rejection mutually plausible and mutually enforceable.

activation_trace.role: A companion joined to a companion supplies the peer links through which the tactic propagates.
Making something appear good supplies the reinforcement that renders the group's rejection attractive.
Circulating speech carries the instruction across the paired social network.
A group's habitual tongue supplies the repeated discourse that maintains collective resistance.
The hoped-for domination gives the network a shared competitive objective.
Being led away from the intended path reveals the directive agency later blamed within the network.

structural_cues: 41:25 immediately precedes the focus with companions who beautify what surrounds their partners.
41:26 uses plural speakers, plural imperatives, and a plural victory, while 41:29 later seeks the agents of misdirection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies companionship, beautification, plural coordination, and later blame; I infer a peer-amplification network connecting them. A live alternative is that the companions describe a broader moral ecology rather than the immediate noise-makers.

changed_reading.before: A hostile crowd independently shouts over a reciter.
changed_reading.after: Linked peers circulate and reward a shared counter-discourse, making acoustic disruption one practice of a larger social reinforcement system.

context_deltas.mechanism: The hoped-for غلبة is spatially reversed when the same disbelieving collective asks to put its misleaders beneath its feet and among the lowest. The coalition formed to dominate the recitation implodes into an internal hierarchy of trampling and degradation.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering establishes the upward dominance the speakers hope to secure.
Misdirection identifies the former allies who become targets of the reversed dominance.
Position beneath supplies the first downward reversal of the hoped-for victory.
The foot that treads supplies the concrete image of former coalition members subjugating one another.
Descent to the lowest place completes the inversion of anticipated ascendancy.

structural_cues: The focus ends with a plural hope of prevailing; 41:29 returns to the same disbelieving speakers and renders their social hierarchy vertically.
Beneath, feet, and lowest form a concentrated downward sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hoped-for overpowering and a later downward placement of misleaders; I infer a designed reversal of the dominance axis. The alternative is that 41:29 is a punishment image not specifically keyed to 41:26.

changed_reading.before: The coalition expects to dominate the Qur'an and its reciter.
changed_reading.after: Its desired hierarchy reverses inward: the alliance of domination ends with its members seeking to trample and lower their own guides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies a counter-program to 'say, make noise, prevail': best speech calls rather than jams, good action accompanies it, and repelling with what is better converts an enemy into a close ally. The focus becomes the failed coercive mirror of a non-silencing social victory.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the hostile program that the later speech sequence reverses.
False or ugly speech supplies the negative speech-quality answered by what is better.
Coercive overpowering supplies the focus's model of success.
Goodness opposed to ugliness supplies the explicit evaluative reversal of the focus speech.
Uttered speech reappears as the medium of the constructive counter-program.
Calling and drawing by speech replace the focus's attempt to repel by interference.
Removing what is harmful supplies a response to hostility that does not reproduce its noise.
Love, support, and alliance supply the transformed relation produced by the better response.
Near kin-like intimacy gives the transformed enemy relation its strongest social form.

structural_cues: 41:33-34 concentrates speech, calling, better action, enmity, and transformed alliance in one sequence.
Both the focus and the later sequence address how speech acts within conflict, but they produce opposite social outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two speech programs and an explicit enemy-to-ally transformation; I infer that this transformation is the surah's alternative form of victory. The live alternative is that 41:33-34 gives ethical response without intentionally answering تَغْلِبُونَ.

changed_reading.before: The verse records one effective way hostile speech seeks victory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The attempt to make لغو 'in it' sounds like an invasion of the recitation, but the later book is difficult to reach and falsehood cannot arrive at it. The repeated ear-weight and distant call relocate the effect: noise does not enter and corrupt the Qur'an; it burdens and displaces the hearer.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted false speech, an unbreached book, burdened ears, and a distant call; I infer that the damage is transferred from text to receiver. A live alternative is that فِيهِ simply means making noise during the recitation and never implied textual corruption.

changed_reading.after: The Qur'an remains unbreached; the counter-speech instead makes its practitioners heavy-eared and acoustically remote from what is still calling them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the second غلب branch is a material image of thickness and interweaving rather than ordinary victory. It remains anchored in تَغْلِبُونَ beside mixed noise and gives a coherent masking mechanism, but downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy, not a lexical replacement for prevailing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacency of mixed noisy لغو and the thickening/interweaving branch of غلب permits a sound-mesh image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-scene reading is surprising because it compares a human propaganda order with the cosmic speech sequence rather than claiming a direct lexical gloss. It remains anchored in the focus's قول, blocked receptive سمع, and noisy response, but should be rendered as a whole-surah inversion: one command elicits willing answer while the other organizes non-reception.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's spoken command against receptive hearing can be set against 41:11-12, where command is received, answered, and obeyed.

activation_trace.role: Uttered command and uttered answer supply a completed speech-response circuit.
Willing compliance supplies the reception outcome inverted by the focus command.
Divinely conveyed information extends the model from hearing a command to receiving ordered communication.

Mixed noise replaces the willing answer with an engineered anti-response.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains an ordinary hostile instruction.
changed_reading.after: It can be carried as an inverted ordering speech-act: instead of communication producing reception and willing response, command is used to organize non-reception.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a scale analogy, surprising because horizons, selves, witness, and encompassing knowledge are not acoustic glosses. It remains anchored in the focus's local attempt to overwhelm a recited sign, but downstream prose should qualify the claim: the whole-surah field outscales the tactic rather than the roots directly redefining لغو or غلب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The local hope that mixed noise can prevail is outscaled by signs distributed across horizons and selves and by encompassing witness.

activation_trace.role: Mixed local sound supplies the bounded interference whose scale is tested.
The hope of overpowering supplies the scale claim that the later field reverses.
Visible signs supply evidence that is not confined to one recitation event.
Far horizons distribute the evidentiary field beyond the local acoustic venue.
The self as the very identity of the thing places evidence inside the would-be noise-maker as well.
Witness grounded in knowledge closes the evidentiary field around the local denial.
Complete encompassing in knowledge prevents local interference from defining the total field.

changed_reading.before: Controlling one auditory scene could plausibly defeat the message.
changed_reading.after: The tactic is radically local: the surah distributes signs across outer and inner fields that noise cannot enclose or outscale.

strongest_changes: The focus became a manufactured-deafness operation that externalizes the coverings, ear-weight, and barrier of 41:4-5.
Later sensory testimony recast suppression as failed control of an auditory witness.
Companion reinforcement and the downward imagery of 41:29 turned collective victory into a social network that finally inverts against itself.
The best-speech sequence supplied a rival model of success: transform enmity rather than silence an opponent.
The protected-book and distant-call sequence relocated the tactic's damage from the Qur'an to the burdened, displaced hearer.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction exposed a repeated chain of acoustic, social, evidentiary, and spatial reversals around the focus's compact progression from speech to blocked hearing, noise, and hoped-for dominance.
remaining_uncertainties: فِيهِ may mean making noise during or against the recitation without implying an attempted intrusion into the text.
The witness-control reading is retrospective and need not describe the speakers' conscious motive.
The companion network may name a broader moral ecology rather than the immediate noise-makers.
The thick sound mesh, inverted cosmic command, and distributed-sign scale model remain explicitly analogical.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Noise is used to block compliant hearing.** **س م ع B003** supplies understanding and compliance; **ل غ و B003** noisy raised sound and **ل غ و B001** what is set aside as not counting; **غ ل ب B001** overpowering force. The commands coordinate refusal and noise toward dominance. I infer a deliberate signal-jamming mechanism: raise non-counting sound so gathered speech cannot become understood obligation. The ayah reads as acoustic power strategy.
2. **Scattered sound attacks gathered recitation.** **ق ر ء B001** gives gathering speech into recitation, while **ل غ و B002/B003** gives vain speech and noisy sound. Their structural opposition is material: coherent gathering is met by disruptive excess. I infer that victory is imagined as preventing verbal parts from cohering in listeners. This preserves a distinct compositional reading.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:44 shows that the tactic becomes internalized as ear-weight and blindness even when articulation is clear. 41:53 counters local noise with signs distributed across horizons and selves, a field too broad to silence by one auditory intervention.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Coherent gathered speech is attacked by acoustic flooding.** Lexically, `ق ر ء B001` gathers speech into recitation, `ل غ و B003` is noisy raised sound used to confuse, `س م ع B003` is understanding and compliance, and `غ ل ب B001` coercive overpowering. Structurally, the imperatives prohibit listening and command noise “in it,” with victory as their purpose; 41:20–22 had just made hearing an accountable witness. I assign Qurʾanic gathering the role of coherent signal, clamor the role of channel interference, and victory the role of controlling whether signal becomes understanding. The inferred arrow is that acoustic saturation prevents semantic integration without answering the speech. The ayah reads as an explicit communication-denial strategy rather than intellectual refutation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:27 immediately reversed acoustic refusal into bodily tasting, confirming that the strategy targeted reception rather than truth. 41:30’s descending reassurance later contrasted a speech channel that supports uprightness with clamor designed to block it.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر للزارع والكفار للزراع لأنهم يغطون الحب أو البذر بالتراب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافر المضاد للإيمان ولا الكافر للبحر أو الليل
branches.source_phrase_ar: يقال للزارع كافر لأنه يغطى الحب بتراب الأرض (maqayis)؛ الكافر الزارع لأنه يغطي البذر بالتراب (sihah)؛ الزراع لستره البذر في الأرض (mufradat)؛ الكفار الزراع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnızca bağışlama değildir; günah veya bozulmuş yemin karşısında yükü gideren bir işlem ya da karşılık bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem giderici işlemi hem de günahın etkisinin silinmesi sonucunu kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Günah yükünün bir karşılık veya işlemle ortadan kaldırılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemin bozulduğunda doğan özel yükümlülüğün yerine getirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulan yemin nedeniyle gereken karşılığın yerine getirilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemin dışındaki günah ve kötülüklerin giderilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlemin günahı işlenmemiş gibi kılan sonucunun öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günahın etkisini ve yükünü ortadan kaldırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: günahı veya bozulan yeminin yükünü gideren karşılık
bozulan yeminin gerektirdiği yükümlülüğü yerine getirme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal günah veya yemin yükünü belirli bir karşılık ya da işlemle giderir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hak edilmiş cezayı uygulamamayı ve suçu bağışlayarak silmeyi merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Günahın sonucunu ortadan kaldırma ve onu silinmiş sayma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giderici karşılık veya yükümlülük belirleyicidir; komşu dalda belirleyici olan cezadan vazgeçme ve bağışlamadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçmiş eylemin yükünü gideren karşılığı veya işlemi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin günahtan dönmesini ve davranış yönünü değiştirmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da işlenmiş bir günahla ilişkiyi değiştiren dinî-ahlaki bir süreçtir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak yükün silinmesidir; komşu dalda odak kişinin geri dönüşü ve davranışı bırakmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bağışlama ile günahtan dönme, giderici işlem ile sonuç arasındaki sınırı en iyi açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفارة لما يكفر الخطيئة أو اليمين والتكفير للسيئات والمعاصي حتى تصير كأن لم تعمل
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكفر ضد الإيمان ولا كفران النعمة ولا ستر الأشياء الحسية
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفارة ما يكفر به من الخطيئة واليمين فيمحى به (ayn)؛ تكفير اليمين فعل ما يجب بالحنث فيها والاسم الكفارة والتكفير في المعاصي (sihah)؛ الكفارة ما يغطي الإثم والتكفير ستره وتغطيته حتى يصير بمنزلة ما لم يعمل (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: üzüm salkımının veya hurma çiçeğinin kılıfı
hurma çiçeğinin ya da meyvenin kılıfı
hurma ağacından çıkan kapalı çiçek kılıfları

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tahıl tanesi örtüsü ve ekinin kılıfa girme durumu, nesne ve gelişim aşaması sınırlarını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور والكفرى والكوافير لأكمام العنب أو طلع النخل أو الورقة التي تستر الثمرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الكافور الطيب ولا عين الماء ولا النبات ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس أكمام الثمر ولا الطلع ولا الكفر الديني
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور شيء من أخلاط الطيب والكافور عين ماء في الجنة والكافور نبات نوره كنور الأقحوان (ayn)؛ الكافور من الطيب (sihah)؛ الكافور الذي هو من الطيب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insanlardan uzak araziyi temel gönderim olarak verir; köy, köyler, bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar anlamları ise aynı söz ailesinin ayrı sözlük kullanımlarıdır. Tanım bunları tek bir 'ıssız yer' nesnesi gibi özdeşleştirmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Uzak arazi çekirdeği ile köy, halk ve mezar kullanımları ayrı facetlerdir; dağ geçidi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzak araziye bağlı söz öbeği ile yalın köy, mezar ve çoğul yer-halk kullanımları ayrı tutulur; kapsamları tek anlamda eritilmez.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlardan uzak, pek inilmez ve geçilmez bir araziyi anlatır. Aynı söz ailesinde köy, köyler veya bu yerlerin halkı ve mezar için kaydedilmiş ayrı kullanımlar da bulunur.

facets.statement: İnsanlardan uzak, pek uğranmayan veya geçilmeyen arazi.
Köy, köyler ve uzak yerlerin halkı aynı söz ailesinin ayrı yer ve topluluk kullanımlarıdır.
Mezar anlamı tek kaynaklı aktarım içinde verilen ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar insanlardan uzak arazi anlamında birleşir; toplu kanıt ayrıca köy, köylerin halkı ve mezar anlamlarını ortak çekirdekten ayrılması gereken sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.

concept_gloss.text: uzak arazi; köy, uzak yer halkı veya mezar
concept_gloss.applicability: Ana uzak arazi anlamını öne alır ve kaynakta aynı dalda tutulan ayrı yer kullanımlarını açıkça işaretler.

error_profile.preserves: Uzak arazi çekirdeğini; köy, uzak yer halkı ve mezar varyantlarından ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz öbeğinin pek uğranmayan uzak araziyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaklık ve insan uğrağından yoksunluk özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Köy, halk ve mezar kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanlardan uzak araziyi öne çıkarır ve köy ile mezarı ayrı sözlük kullanımları olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü sınırlı yeri; mamur, boş, yerleşik veya ıssız oluşuna bakmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Arazi, köy ve mezar gibi yer gönderimleri iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli sözlük gönderimlerine ve uzaklık koşuluna bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği genel yer kavramıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın ana yeri insanlardan uzak arazidir; ayrıca köy ve mezar kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir yer adı yanında deniz içindeki veya karadan kopuk adayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İnsan yerleşiminden ya da ana karadan ayrılık düşüncesi iki dalı yakınlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uzaklık insanlarla ilişkilidir; komşu dalda fiziksel kopukluk ve ada yapısı belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yer kavramı ile fiziksel kopuk yer, uzaklık koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافر من الأرض البعيد عن الناس والكفور للقرى والكفر للقرية والقبر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الثنايا من الجبال ولا البحر ولا الليل ولا الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر من الأرض ما بعد من الناس وأهل الكفور والقرى (maqayis)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس والكفور القرى (ayn)؛ الكفر أيضا القرية والكفر أيضا القبر (sihah)؛ الكافر من الأرض ما بعد عن الناس (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ geçitlerini, iri bir dağı ve alçak duvarı aynı söz ailesinde sıralar; geçitleri 'örtülü' saymak kaynakta kurucu bir koşul değildir. Dal bu nedenle örtülülük altında birleştirilmeden coğrafi çekirdek ve ayrı duvar kullanımı olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dağ geçidi ve iri dağ coğrafi facetlerdir; alçak duvar ayrı bir sözlük varyantıdır, köy veya uzak arazi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimleri ayrı tutulur; uzak yer veya genel örtme anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dağlar arasındaki geçitler veya iri bir dağ için kullanılan coğrafi bir adlandırmadır; aynı söz ailesinde alçak duvar anlamı da ayrı bir sözlük kullanımı olarak kaydedilir.

facets.statement: Dağlar arasındaki geçit veya geçitler.
İri bir dağ, coğrafi alan içindeki ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.
Alçak duvar, coğrafi çekirdekten ayrı bir sözlük kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların çoğu dağ geçitlerini verir; toplu kanıt iri dağ ve alçak duvar anlamlarını da aynı söz ailesinin ayrı varyantları olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: dağ geçidi; iri dağ veya alçak duvar
concept_gloss.applicability: Dağ geçidi çekirdeğini öne alırken aynı dalda korunan iki ayrı sözlük varyantını da eksiltmeden gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Dağ geçidi, iri dağ ve alçak duvar gönderimlerini birbirinden ayırarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çoğul veya tekil biçimin dağlar arasındaki geçidi gösterdiği coğrafi bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazideki geçit gönderimini doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: İri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dağ geçidi yanında iri dağ ve alçak duvar varyantlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geçidi özellikle dağ veya vadideki yol kıvrımı ve yürünür güzergâh olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazideki geçit iki dalın ortak gönderimidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Geçit gönderiminde yakınlık yüksektir; ancak komşu dal yolun kıvrım ve güzergâh yapısını, bu dal ise ayrı dağ ve duvar varyantlarını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçidin yalnızca dağlık yer türünü adlandırır ve zorluk koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dik, engebeli ve çıkılması güç bir dağ yolunu veya benzer yükseltileri merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Dağlık arazide geçiş sağlayan yer iki dalda da bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeğinde sarplık veya tırmanış şartı yoktur; komşu dalda güç çıkılan yükselen yol belirleyicidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ geçidi ile sarp dağ yolu, geçit türünün ve zorluk koşulunun sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفرات والثنايا من الجبال والكفر العظيم من الجبال والحائط الواطئ
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القرية ولا القبر ولا الأرض البعيدة العامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفرات والكفر الثنايا من الجبال (maqayis)؛ الكفر الثنايا من الجبال (ayn)؛ الكفر العظيم من الجبال (sihah)؛ الكافر الحائط الواطىء (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başla işaret etme ile eli göğse koyup bedenini alçaltmayı, başka birine boyun eğme gösterisinin iki bedensel gerçekleşmesi olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel içsel alçakgönüllülük değil, baş veya el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli bir boyun eğme gösterisidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adı belirli bedensel boyun eğme hareketleriyle sınırlanır; günah giderme veya kişiyi inançsız sayma anlamı eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup bedenini alçaltması yoluyla başka birine boyun eğdiğini göstermesidir.

facets.statement: Bedeni alçaltan bir hareketle başka birine boyun eğme gösterisi yapma.
Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla işaret etmesi veya bir kişinin elini göğsüne koyup eğilmesi, bu gösterinin belirtilen bedensel biçimleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başka birine bedensel olarak boyun eğme çekirdeğinde birleşir; başla işaret ve eli göğse koyarak eğilme iki farklı hareket biçimidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İçsel tutumdan çok baş, el ve gövdeyle yapılan belirli gösteriyi anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel eğilmeyi, yöneldiği kişiyi ve boyun eğme işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğmesi
contextual_glosses.applicability: Koruma altındaki gayrimüslim tebaanın başıyla boyun eğme işareti yaptığı tarihî bağlamda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli törensel beden hareketidir; komşu dal daha geniş bir içsel ve dışsal alçakgönüllülük alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal alnı yere koymayı ve secde biçimindeki boyun eğmeyi de çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bedeni alçaltarak itaat ve saygı gösterme iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Hareketin biçimi farklıdır: bu dal ayakta yapılan eğilme işaretlerini, komşu dal yere kapanmaya kadar uzanan secdeyi kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemini hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini açıkça verir; ancak geçici dal imgesindeki tacın örttüğü düşüncesi bir kaynak iddiası değildir. Süreç ve nesne ayrımı korunarak aynı dalda gösterilebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hükümdarlık tacı ve taç giydirme töreniyle sınırlıdır; genel baş örtüsü veya boyun eğme hareketi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem adının taç giydirme süreci ve taç nesnesi gönderimleri birlikte fakat ayrı facetlerde korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemidir; aynı söz bu işlemde kullanılan tacın kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Bir hükümdarın başına taç koyarak onu taçlandırma işlemi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, hükümdarı taçlandırma süreci ile bu süreçte kullanılan taç nesnesini aynı sözün iki bağlı gönderimi olarak kaydeder.

source_details.summary: Söz hem hükümdara taç giydirme işlemi hem de bu işlemde kullanılan tacın adı olarak aktarılır.

error_profile.preserves: Taçlandırma işlemini, hükümdar katılımcısını ve taç nesnesini korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hükümdarın başına taç koyma işlemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tacın kendisini adlandıran nesne gönderimini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Baş üzerine taç koyma ve bunu egemenlik işareti yapma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal taç ve hükümdarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal sarık, başa geçirme ve topluluğun kişiyi önder sayması gibi daha geniş süreçleri de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Taç, başın üstüne konan bir nesne olarak iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal hükümdarlık ve taçlandırma işlevine bağlıdır; komşu dalın çekirdeği başa konan nesnelerin genel sınıfıdır.

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları fiziksel örtme çekirdeğinden gece ve suyun örtücülüğüne, tohum ile bitki kılıflarına, dinî gerçeği veya nimeti reddetmeye ve günah yükünü gidermeye uzanan radyal bir yapı gösterir; ayrıca uzak yer, dağ geçidi, boyun eğme, taçlandırma ve aynı biçimli bitki-madde adları gibi sözlüksel olarak ayrışmış dallar bulunur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, sesin kulakla algılanmasını temel alır; bunun yanında dikkatle dinleme ve dinlemeye çağırma kullanımlarını da açıkça içerir. Bu nedenle dalın duyma ve dinleme çerçevesi kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, kulağın kendisini, ün kazanmayı ve şarkı söylemeyi değil, sesin işitsel olarak algılanmasını kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın duyma çekirdeğini korur; dikkatle dinleme, dinlemeye çağırma ve çok dinleyen kişi anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir sesi kulak yoluyla algılamak veya dikkati o sese yönelterek dinlemektir; bazı biçimler birini dinlemeye çağırır ya da çokça dinleyen kişiyi niteler.

facets.statement: Ses, kulak aracılığıyla fark edilir ve işitsel algıya dönüşür.
Dikkat sese çevrildiğinde eylem, edilgin duymadan amaçlı dinlemeye geçer.
Bazı kalıplar dinlemeye çağrı bildirir veya çokça dinleyen kişiyi niteler.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sesin kulakla algılanması çekirdeğinde birleşir; dikkatle dinleme ve dinlemeye yönelten söyleyişler bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesin kulakla algılanmasını ve dikkat sese yöneltildiğinde ortaya çıkan amaçlı dinlemeyi birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İşitsel algıyı ve amaçlı dinleme ayrımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sesin herhangi bir özel dikkat vurgusu olmadan kulakla algılandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sesin kulakla algılanması çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Amaçlı ve dikkatli dinleme yönünü tek başına belirtmez.

error_profile.preserves: Dikkatin sese yöneltilmesi özelliğini korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın organ anlamıyla sınırlıdır; aynı biçimin kova, yük kabı veya bağlama aracındaki benzetmeli kullanımları bu dala taşınmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, sözün kulağa ulaşmasından sonraki iletişim sürecinde art arda yer alır.
